appraisal_events.evidence: elle que jadis tout le monde suivait... Elle était si bien encagée... cette actrice si convoitée n'était-ce pas elle qui, retirée par moi de la scène, enfermée chez moi, était à l'abri des désirs de tous
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine, once a publicly admired figure who dominated attention and drew pursuit at Balbec, is now narrated as confined within the narrator's home, withdrawn from that admired public 'stage' and shut away from the desire of others.

status_effects.explanation: She is removed from the admired, courted public life she had at Balbec and kept sequestered, excluded from the pursuit and desire of others.
The narrator frames his possession of Albertine as a private triumph, having exclusively captured, 'plucked,' and secluded the girl everyone else once desired.
